schema.name: Customer
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Customer" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "phone" TEXT,
    "email" TEXT,
    "customerSegment" TEXT,
    "customerCategory" TEXT,
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '잠재고객',
    "grade" TEXT,
    "tags" TEXT,
    "source" TEXT,
    "collectedAt" DATETIME,
    "referrer" TEXT,
    "leadType" TEXT,
    "assignee" TEXT,
    "isAgent" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "memo" TEXT,
    "birthYear" INTEGER,
    "regionCity" TEXT,
    "regionDist" TEXT,
    "gender" TEXT,
    "birthInfo" TEXT,
    "maritalStatus" TEXT,
    "childrenCount" INTEGER,
    "addressDetail" TEXT,
    "isSoleProprietor" BOOLEAN,
    "soleBusinessName" TEXT,
    "soleBusinessNo" TEXT,
    "soleBusinessType" TEXT,
    "b2bCategory" TEXT,
    "companyName" TEXT,
    "businessRegNo" TEXT,
    "contactTitle" TEXT,
    "industry" TEXT,
    "companyAddress" TEXT,
    "companyPhone" TEXT,
    "employeeCount" INTEGER,
    "mainContactCardUrl" TEXT,
    "contactsJson" TEXT,
    "hasVehicle" BOOLEAN,
    "vehicleMaker" TEXT,
    "vehicleName" TEXT,
    "vehiclePlateNo" TEXT,
    "vehicleYear" TEXT,
    "totalMileage" INTEGER,
    "truckType1" TEXT,
    "truckType2" TEXT,
    "truckType3" TEXT,
    "truckType4" TEXT,
    "vehicleCount" INTEGER,
    "vehicleListJson" TEXT,
    "documentsJson" TEXT,
    "b2bRevenue1" TEXT,
    "b2bRevenue2" TEXT,
    "b2bRevenue3" TEXT,
    "shipperName" TEXT,
    "cargoType" TEXT,
    "deliveryCity" TEXT,
    "deliveryDist" TEXT,
    "deliveryFreq" TEXT,
    "workShift" TEXT,
    "monthlyIncome" TEXT,
    "cargoNote" TEXT,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL
)

schema.name: CustomerActivity
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "CustomerActivity" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "customerId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "type" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "date" DATETIME NOT NULL,
    "content" TEXT,
    "result" TEXT,
    "nextAction" TEXT,
    "assignee" TEXT,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT "CustomerActivity_customerId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("customerId") REFERENCES "Customer" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
)

schema.name: InquirySyncRun
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "InquirySyncRun" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "source" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "companyScopeId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "homepageScopeId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',

    "unchangedCount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    "errorType" TEXT,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
